verdict.rationale: Airwallex is a hosted financial platform. Self-hosted deployment is a fair openness question for a software platform, so the axis applies, but no evidence shows a self-hostable or on-prem version of the core product. The CLI, SDKs, sandbox and AgentOS are client-side tools or hosted environments, not self-hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
